title: Polynomial circuit size equals polynomial advice time
statement: The class of Boolean languages decidable by a family of fan-in-two circuits whose sizes are bounded by a polynomial in the input length equals the class decidable in polynomial time by a Turing machine given an advice string depending only on the input length, where the advice length is polynomially bounded.
